notes: Each dictation now stays on your clipboard after it is inserted, so if a paste missed you can paste it again. A dictation that came in parts is on the clipboard whole. New in Settings: Restore my previous clipboard after inserting. Turn it on and Koegaki puts back what you had copied before, once the paste lands. Off is the default. If part of a dictation could not be inserted, the warning now points you to Paste last dictation in the tray, which has all of it.
